articles.title: Payton Tolle pitches 8-inning gem as Red Sox end 5-game skid with 7-0 win over Blue Jays
articles.description:
Boston's skid matched its worst of the season, but the Red Sox remain comfortably in position for an AL wild-card playoff berth.

summary: Red Sox ended a 5-game losing streak with a 7-0 victory over the Blue Jays.

The win keeps Boston in a strong position for an AL wild-card playoff berth.

articles.title: Graham Platner to speak at labor rally, one of his first public events since ending Maine campaign
articles.description:
Platner won Maine's Democratic primary for the right to challenge veteran Republican Sen. Susan Collins, but he dropped out in July after Politico reported that a former girlfriend said he sexually assaulted her.

The post Graham Platner to speak at labor rally, one of his first public events since ending Maine campaign appeared first on Boston.com.
summary: Graham Platner will speak at a labor rally in Boston on August 20.

His appearance raises questions about local labor support amid his controversial past.
